authority: Existing implementation goal; DEC006 bounded runtime/process mechanism, DEC015 AppServerv2, DEC016 confinement and REQ021 actual identity evidence remain unchanged. No globally idle account requirement is added. REQ020 stops repeated unchanged static-list retries.
finding: Static exact concurrency lists cannot account for newly user-created external tasks/projects after a run baseline. Attempt7 added one external row/log and project/root counts with no changed prior thread/log entries. Counts alone cannot identify project additions or preservation.
unchanged_requirements: All21 foundation criteria and full NP001-014 remain required; P1 stays mechanism-only.
Actual controller/fork/manager handoff, equal settings, context/helper isolation, owner calls and local stop evidence remain mandatory.
Immutable initial metadata baseline, current protected source/profile/tool bindings, original deadlines and all runtime/model/cell/archive limits remain.
No automatic unknown-thread allowlist, global ignore, unrelated task control, archive/rename allowance, body/title/config/credential reads or index edits.
smallest_mechanism: Add an opt-in P1-only AmbientMetadataReview selection to the existing NativeStorageAdmission verification class; without it preserve the current unconditional mismatch rejection. Runtime actors receive no new capability or tool.

Freeze the existing baseline plus exact selected project metadata at launch. Retain immutable baseline bytes/digests. Represent later host-reviewed ambient additions in a separate ordered append-only delta chain; never replace initial inventories or clear mismatches.

Check selected metadata before new supervised turn admission and at existing visibility/final gates. If a new unexplained delta appears, close all new proof model/allocation/owner-tool admission first. Offer a host-review hold only when every owned native turn is observed terminal, no pending native/owner mutation/callback/release is unresolved, and no actor status is uncertain. Otherwise preserve failure and stop.

While held, permit only bounded diagnostic metadata reads, safe native status/error/stop handling, and trusted host receipt polling. A model tool callback received during the hold cannot dispatch an owner mutation, consume a grant, allocate an actor or resume work. No extra prompt/model turn is used to ask for the host decision.

Construct one bounded challenge from the immutable baseline plus prior reviewed deltas: exact new thread IDs/stable metadata, JSONL path/device/inode/UID/mode/link/size/mtime, exact new projects/project_roots rows, current selected history-index metadata for only those external IDs, proof actor/operation ledger exclusion and checkpoint quiescence evidence. Preserve raw metadata observation and challenge digest in trusted storage.

Root independently observes each candidate external native ID in the actual app listing and verifies its scoped metadata/path and associated project allocation. A host decision is ingested through the existing protected manager/host receipt path, not a native caller-supplied field. App visibility is bounded evidence and does not prove writer causation or confer control authority.

Accept only the exact current challenge using a fresh exclusive regular receipt bound to packet digest, immutable baseline digest, ordered previous-receipt digest, batch number, challenge digest and exact IDs/rows. Reopen metadata after receipt. Reject unexplained additional changes; only selected monotonic external progress from the frozen challenge observation may advance. Commit the next delta receipt without editing the baseline.

Reopen admission only after the complete current comparison equals baseline plus validated proof-owned records and the cumulative explicitly reviewed ambient delta chain. Keep external IDs outside pool reservations/owners/grants/capacity and apply the existing identity-preserving monotonic progress rules. Unknown final cleanup changes remain failures; final cleanup never starts a new review wait or extends its deadline.

rules: All baseline selected project/root rows stay exactly fixed. Only fully identified additions associated with explicitly reviewed external task cwd paths may be appended. Counts must equal the exact row inventories.
Native thread.project_id may be null. Native project ID and app project ID remain distinct; bind exact project_roots path association and each observation source, never assume identical IDs.
Removal, rename/archive, altered existing project/root row, duplicate root mapping, unrelated new project or unexplained count change fails.

proposed_finite_limits.deadline: Every hold, observation and recheck consumes the original1800-second work budget; no timer reset. Existing60-second cleanup/final15-second metadata reserve unchanged.
proposed_finite_limits.existing_limits: All selected per-scan/file/row/history/wire/turn/cell/tool limits remain. Over-budget evidence holds/fails; no truncation.

acceptance_cases: Actual disposable metadata mismatch yields a challenge with admission closed and immutable baseline bytes untouched; the exact current root receipt accepts only its additions.

Exercise baseline plus two ordered review batches and later allowed external progress; exact cumulative replay reconstructs the expected state. Independent app/native IDs and null native thread.project_id remain distinct.

Reject changed/removal of baseline rows/logs, old-file substitution, aliases/hardlinks/special paths, archival/root changes, unselected project rows, count-only ambiguity and unknown schema fields without accepting a delta.

Reject wrong scope/baseline/previous receipt/challenge/IDs, duplicate or stale receipt, proof-owned actor as external, path under proof/protected candidate roots and missing independent external observation.

Prove pending hold denies a model start, native allocation and actual Broker-to-owner mutation before effect/grant consumption; active or uncertain actor/callback/release state cannot enter a resumable hold.
Reopen immediately before adoption and catch additional unlisted change; bound allowed monotonic growth to the challenge baseline and reject regression even if above an older host receipt.
Rejection, absent receipt, exhausted batch/byte/checkpoint budget or shared deadline causes bounded cleanup and original failed evidence; unknown final-storage change cannot preserve a pass.
Rerun affected existing storage preservation, concurrency progress, chunk/pre-ACK and owner-order tests; frozen source-derived wire preflight must remain valid. No broad unrelated test rewrite.
implementation_disposition: Bounded correction to verification accounting within the accepted target, owned by the same dedicated implementer after current stopped-instance/context rebind. No new product workflow or source guard limit change. Freeze source/checks and a new exact one-attempt packet for independent manager/host assessment before any native run.
open_scope: None for this assessment. Concrete native launch remains unapproved; any inability to meet the exact bounds or quiescence/receipt gates must be returned before implementation expands.
